procedural_matters: GBR 334 was represented by Eliza PRITCHARD.
facts: At the start of race 8, GBR 334 was penalised in accordance with RRS P 1.2 for ooching by an observer of the international jury.
Nacra 15 class rules do not provide for flag “O” under appendix P5.
After the penalty was signalled, GBR 334 gybed and continued sailing on port tack. As a result, GBR 334 was scored DSQ in race 8.
conclusions: There was no failure to take into account a race committee signal or a class rule. Therefore, redress shall not be given to GBR 334 as provided by RRS P4.
